notes.title: Finally the game got beaten!
notes.content:
It should take almost 2 years, but finally the user [b]ryederek[/b] did it. He beat the game in 52 minutes by completing all 40 levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925925/3bf5b5f94ef890b38960ee3c7fc539664b1fd08e.png[/img]

Huge congratulations to him!!

And now... Lets see if others can break his record ːsteamhappyː
